canonical_records: transpara-ai/docs gate standard 4.3.0 pending docs#272 reconciliation

findings.finding: The serialized optional policy label is easy to confuse with a discretionary bypass even though transitions deny ordinary-work skips.
findings.evidence: The design preserves wire compatibility, documents class-conditional semantics, and adds complete decision-vector tests.

findings.finding: The current prototype transition leaves IADA failed rather than explicitly omitted, making projection evidence ambiguous.
findings.evidence: Design v0.1.1 selects one atomic IADA/CFADA skipped projection and requires golden/replay/Hive compatibility proof.

findings.finding: A maturity flag entering skipAllowed would convert birth maturity into a governance bypass.
findings.evidence: The design keeps maturity out of runtime exemption logic and tests both maturities against each governance class.

residual_risks: Changing IADA projection from failed to skipped may reveal an undocumented consumer assumption and must return to HDR if so.
The copied contract fixture requires strict version/hash coordination to avoid drift.
Hive compile/consumer verification may be necessary even though Hive source changes are out of scope.
non_authorizations: No reviewer runtime, Hive mutation, EventGraph write, deploy, merge, or issue closure.
